# Load data

```{r}
rm(list=ls())

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(Hmisc)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(reghelper)

#setwd("mypath")

# main dataset from experimental sessions including: momentary psychological measures, salivary cortisol (sCort) and salivary alpha amylase (sAA); all measures  have one value per study measurement point (once an hour or once every two hours)
dat <- read_excel("lab_data_main_2022-03-08.xlsx")

# heart rate (HR) dataset from experimental sessions; one value per minute
dat_hr <- read_excel("lab_data_HR_2022-03-08.xlsx")

# dataset of psychological measures, sCort, and sAA collected the morning after each session; one value per morning
dat_m  <- read_excel("lab_data_morning_2022-05-06.xlsx")

```

# DV descriptive statistics (SM tables 2 and 3)

## Psychological variables, sCort and sAA (SM Table 2)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
DV <- c("anxiety_VAS","control_VAS","stress_VAS","avoid_VAS","MDBF_valence_mood","MDBF_calmness_mood","MDBF_energy_mood","MFI_general_fatigue","MFI_physical_fatigue","MFI_mental_fatigue","MFI_reduced_motivation","MFI_reduced_activity","hunger_VAS","loneliness_VAS","desire_food_VAS","desire_soc_VAS", "sCort", "sAA")

for (i in 1: length(DV)){
  t <- dat[, c("ID", "Condition", "hours_num", DV[i])]
  names(t) <- c("ID","Condition", "hours_num", "x")
  t <- t %>% 
    group_by(Condition, hours_num) %>%
    summarise(M = mean(x, na.rm=TRUE), SD_b = sd(x, na.rm=TRUE), N = length(!is.na(x))) %>%
    mutate (CI_down = M - qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N), CI_up = M + qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N)) %>%
    ungroup %>%
    group_by(Condition) %>%
    mutate(M_ov = mean(M, na.rm=TRUE), SD_ov = mean(SD_b, na.rm=TRUE),  
           CI_down_ov = mean(CI_down, na.rm=TRUE), CI_up_ov = mean(CI_up, na.rm=TRUE))
  t$var <- DV[i]
  
  if (i==1){
    Mt <- t
  }else{
    Mt <- rbind(Mt,t)
  }
}

# Per condition and hour
Mt[c(1:7,12)]

# Per condition
unique(Mt[c(1,5,8:12)])
```

## Heart rate (SM Table 2)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# exclude data that is not valid due to technical bugs (see Methods section of the paper)
dat_hr <- dat_hr[-which(dat_hr$HR_drop==TRUE),]

t <- dat_hr[, c("ID", "Condition", "hours", "M_bpm")]
t <- t %>% 
  group_by(Condition, hours) %>%
  summarise(M = mean(M_bpm, na.rm=TRUE), SD_b = sd(M_bpm, na.rm=TRUE), N = length(!is.na(M_bpm))) %>%
  mutate (CI_down = M - qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N), CI_up = M + qnorm(0.975)*SD_b/sqrt(N)) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(M_ov = mean(M, na.rm=TRUE), SD_ov = mean(SD_b, na.rm=TRUE),  
         CI_down_ov = mean(CI_down, na.rm=TRUE), CI_up_ov = mean(CI_up, na.rm=TRUE))

# Per condition and hour
t[c(1:4,6:7)]

# Per condition
unique(t[c(1,8:11)])
```

  }

Mt

# Mediation analysis (SM7)

```{r}
# subject number of each participant
dat$ID <- as.factor(dat$ID)

# experimental condition - "Baseline" is a reference category compared to "Fasting" and "Isolation"
dat$Condition <- as.factor(dat$Condition)
dat$Condition <- factor(dat$Condition, levels = c("Baseline", "Isolation", "Fasting"))

#################################### 
### MEDIATION ANALYSIS
#################################### 

# select the data we want 

mdat <- subset(dat,Condition!="Fasting")
mdat <- mdat[c("ID","MFI_general_fatigue","Condition","hours_num","boredom_VAS","MDBF_energy_mood")]
mdat <-mdat[complete.cases(mdat),]

# set seed to reproduce results 
set.seed(1111)

# need to detach lmerTest to run mediation 
# I copy and pasted the ouput with the p values for the models 
detach("package:lmerTest",unload=T)


```

## Boredom ~ fatigue

```{r}
#################################### 
### boredom ~ fatigue
#################################### 

fatigue.fit.mediator = lmer(boredom_VAS~ Condition + hours_num+(hours_num|ID),
                   mdat,  REML = TRUE,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
summary(fatigue.fit.mediator)

fatigue.fit.dv <- lmer(MFI_general_fatigue ~ Condition + boredom_VAS + hours_num+(hours_num|ID),
               mdat, REML = TRUE,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
summary(fatigue.fit.dv)


fatigue.results = mediation::mediate(fatigue.fit.mediator, fatigue.fit.dv, treat="Condition",mediator="boredom_VAS")
summary(fatigue.results)
```

## Boredom ~ energy

```{r}
#################################### 
### boredom ~ energy
#################################### 

energy.fit.mediator = lmer(boredom_VAS~ Condition + hours_num+(hours_num|ID),
                            mdat,  REML = TRUE,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
summary(energy.fit.mediator)


energy.fit.dv <- lmer(MDBF_energy_mood ~ Condition + boredom_VAS + hours_num+(hours_num|ID),
                       mdat, REML = TRUE,control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))
summary(energy.fit.dv)
 

energy.results = mediation::mediate(energy.fit.mediator, energy.fit.dv, treat="Condition",mediator="boredom_VAS")
summary(energy.results)

```

# Salivary cortisol and alpha amylase results on the full sample with non-transformed data (SM Table 6)

## 1. sCort - momentary values

### Main effect of condition

```{r}
library(lmerTest)

mod.cort_me <- lmer(sCort ~ Condition + hours_num + (hours_num|ID), data = dat, REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

# (Condition + hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')
# (Condition |ID) boundary (singular) fit: see help('isSingular')

summary(mod.cort_me)

# adjusted p values - Bonferroni correction
p1<- summary(mod.cort_me)$coefficients[,"Pr(>|t|)"]
p_adjusted <- p1*3
round(p_adjusted,3)[2:4]



```

### Interaction between condition and time

```{r}

mod.cort_int <- lmer(sCort ~ Condition * hours_num + (hours_num |ID), data = dat, REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

# Random effect structure of more complex models that did not converge:
#   (Condition * hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular
#   (Condition + hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular
#   (Condition |ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular

summary(mod.cort_int)

# adjusted p values - Bonferroni correction
p1<- summary(mod.cort_int)$coefficients[,"Pr(>|t|)"]
p_adjusted <- p1*3
round(p_adjusted,3)[5:6]

```

## 2. sAA - momentary values

### Main effect of condition

```{r}

mod.AA_me <- lmer(sAA ~ Condition + hours_num + (Condition |ID), data = dat, REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

#   (Condition + hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular


summary(mod.AA_me)

# adjusted p values - Bonferroni correction
p1<- summary(mod.AA_me)$coefficients[,"Pr(>|t|)"]
p_adjusted <- p1*3
round(p_adjusted,3)[2:4]

```

### Interaction between condition and time

```{r}

mod.AA_int <- lmer(sAA ~ Condition * hours_num + (Condition |ID), data = dat, REML = TRUE, control=lmerControl(optimizer="bobyqa", optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e5)))

# Random effect structure of more complex models that did not converge:
#   (Condition * hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular
#   (Condition + hours_num|ID) boundary (singular) fit: see ?isSingular

summary(mod.AA_int)

# adjusted p values - Bonferroni correction
p1<- summary(mod.AA_int)$coefficients[,"Pr(>|t|)"]
p_adjusted <- p1*3
round(p_adjusted,3)[5:6]

# simple slope analysis of interaction between baseline:fasting and time
simple_slopes(mod.AA_int, levels=list(Condition=c("Baseline", "Fasting")))

```
